text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria shifts up another gear. Her 
light, effortless footwork almost makes it 
look easy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Graceful and supple like a gentle breeze. 
Gran Alegria stormed past the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: No way... I lost?! Ehhhhhh--?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was a mile! Even though I 
was going for a record time!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I had such a good 130-mile run! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so, so mad—!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think I let my guard down... But 
if I couldn't win, I guess that's what 
happened.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! And after I ran the best race of my 
life, too...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even though I ran the best race of my 
life, if I do say so myself... I still 
lost...
choice_data_list: But the performance itself was good!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was able to show a performance that 
proved her superior talent. Many must have 
realized she is on a completely different 
level.
choice_data_list:
I'm not worn out this time, and I'm 
feeling strong!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it feels great! So, next up is the 
Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's revenge! And I'm gonna race 
Love-chan. Because we made a promise!
choice_data_list: The Oaks is 2,400 meters, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's medium distance, right? So while 
I'm at it, I'll conquer medium distance 
too!
choice_data_list:
No, no, no... Let's think this through 
calmly.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Judging by how it felt today, I think we 
can do it! We can win the 1.5 miles too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria refused to back down an inch. 
It seemed having a discussion right here 
would be difficult...
choice_data_list:
...Could you give me some time to consider 
it?

...Could you give me some time to consider 
it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. You need time to think 
over training plans and such, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Then let's consider it once we get back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, during morning class hours, 
I consulted with Master regarding the next 
race.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Talk about a high-class problem. I 
guess that's the kind of trouble you run 
into when you're too talented.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
All jokes aside, we need to properly 
convince them. I will attend the 
discussion as well.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you prepare a next target race 
that can convince Gran."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Is your concern that we don't have much 
time until the Oaks, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
True, I haven't trained for medium 
distances, but... lately my stamina's been 
building up bit by bit, too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Judging by how it felt to run the Oka 
Sho, I think I can win the Oaks too!"
choice_data_list: No. There's a much bigger problem here.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Like what?
choice_data_list:
It's because your body still isn't fully 
developed yet.

Because your body isn't fully developed 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Gran is still midway through her physical 
maturation. Her muscle mass and build are 
overwhelmingly insufficient.
choice_data_list:
I think it's still too tough to run middle 
distance.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Growth spurts can make things unstable. 
For instance, as your strength increases, 
your stride length changes. Which means 
the feel of your running changes quite a 
bit too.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Try running a Medium distance you're not 
suited for in that condition. Your entire 
running form could completely fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ! ...A total collapse...
choice_data_list:
If it collapses, you might not be able to 
put it back together, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If that happens, you could become more 
prone to injury, or even completely unable 
to win."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which means... it could even impact her 
racing career as a whole.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Unable to break free from a losing 
streak... there were girls in the past 
whose spirits broke completely.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Your racing career is still far from over. 
With talent like Gran's, you're sure to 
set all kinds of records.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
More than the victory right before your 
eyes... I want you to cherish your future.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: My... future...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And guiding you to a better future— 
is the Trainer's job.
choice_data_list:
How about the NHK Mile Cup for your next 
race?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The NHK Mile Cup—that's 1,600m at Tokyo 
Racecourse, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: I see, Rhein Kraft, huh.
choice_data_list:
Yes. We're going down the irregular Double 
Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The unorthodox double crown of the Oka Sho 
and the NHK Mile Cup. It was a racing 
rotation first blazed by Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back when almost every Umamusume on the 
Tiara route proceeded to the Oaks, 
entering the NHK Mile Cup caused quite a 
stir.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You could truly say she paved the way for 
sprinter and miler Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Not proceeding to the Oaks—that choice 
carries a message of its own."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: A deeper message?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A race that can truly convince her... 
There's no other proof to rely on than 
this—!
choice_data_list:
Show them that Triple Crown Umamusume 
aren't the only strong ones!

Show them that Triple Crown Umamusume 
aren't the only strong ones.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ! I see, the strongest on the mile...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she possesses talent surpassing 
even historical Triple Crown Umamusume, 
there is true meaning in running the NHK 
Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Rather than the Triple Crown, I want to be 
the undisputed Mile Champion— And because 
it's me, I can prove it!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That sounds infinitely thrilling to the 
max!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The road to the strongest isn't just the 
Oaks! I want to prove that to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It's decided, then. I'm just glad Gran 
didn't push herself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... For me, '8 Mile' really hit home.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just about winning the race. You 
were thinking about my future too, weren't 
you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So that I can keep running safely, for a 
long, long time—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Because I want to keep running too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be in your care for the NHK Mile 
Cup!"
